distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports the first Taiwan record from Nantou, Hui Son and Neimoupu, with multiple records from 2004–2007. Smith et al. (2022) adds mainland China records from Fujian and Yunnan, with locality evidence from Fujian, Sanming City and Yunnan, Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, and independently reports Taiwan.

host_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Quercus spp. and Ilex spp. from Japan; these non-China host records remain source context only. Smith et al. (2022) reports no host for the China record, so no host is promoted into the China host synthesis.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Microperus kirishimanus (Murayama, 1955).

taxonomic_history.name: Microperus kirishimanus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) transfers the species to Microperus. Canonical identity and authorship follow integrated taxonomic backbone: Microperus kirishimanus (Murayama, 1955), VSN_3685.
